newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - SCA 9-mo profit seen down 47 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - SCA 9-mo profit seen down 47 pct.

text.p: Swedish forestry company Svenska Cellulosa AB (SCA) is forecast to report a sharply lower profit after financial items of 2.30 billion crowns for the first nine months of 1996, a Reuter poll of 15 anaysts found on Monday.
In the corresponding period a year ago the company reported a profit of 4.31 billion crowns so the average forecast indicated a slump of 47 percent.
In the first half of 1996 SCA made a profit of 1.67 billion crowns which means that earnings in the third quarter of the year were expected to be around 600 million crowns.
For the full year 1996 the average of analysts' forecasts indicated a profit of 3.30 billion crowns compared with a profit of 5.73 billion crowns in 1995.
Since the previous Reuter poll, conducted ahead of the six month report, the average forecast for the full year has fallen by 250 million crowns.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Danske Bank, Enskilda, Fiba, Goldman Sachs, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Grenfell, Morgan Stanley, Nordiska, Penser, Salomon, Swedbank, and Ohman.
SCA is due to release its nine month report on October 30. (Million crowns) AVG RANGE ANALYSTS
